title: Degenerate Bifurcations and Universal Relaxation Scaling in Black Hole Thermodynamics
summary: We present a dynamical systems approach to black hole thermodynamic criticality based on bifurcation equations. We construct an effective thermodynamic landscape in which black holes relax toward equilibrium fixed points. To describe this process, we introduce a flow parameter $τ$, interpreted as a phenomenological relaxation time, which governs the approach toward equilibrium configurations in thermodynamic state space.
